name: Ferret Frenzy — Revision 3.3 Pass 5 + Integrated Narrator
notes: Pass 7: full narrator speech + chat integration, narrator speech mastered by the global sound toggle, public Discord-inspired gameplay channels, and Zoom-inspired turn-floor controls. Existing backend remains unchanged. Package normalized per user request: docs/tests flattened; role-card images flattened into assets/images; assets/code contains frenzy.html only.

backend.note: Existing tested Google Apps Script backend is referenced only. No .gs backend file is included, generated, or modified.

botEngine.mode: frontend guest bots for browser-owned autofill seats
botEngine.roleSource: authoritative game.state startingRole after backend deal
botEngine.seatFill: When Fill Empty Seats is enabled, Bots v3 guest seats fill empty target seats before game.start; each bot loads its role-specific brain only after the backend deal returns startingRole.

nightLock.display: black viewport overlay with frenzy_logo.png; surrounding shell/HUD and live Burrow Clock remain visible
nightLock.chitter: ferret_sound.mp3 layers quietly when sanitized state/events expose Bandit/Raider/accomplice activity; Solo + Bots can also use locally managed bot state already owned by the host controller; no identity is displayed

minnowHitbox.eligiblePlayer: starting BANDIT + isRaider=true + current Night hour is one of that player’s wake hours
minnowHitbox.result: pre-theft scene changes immediately to assets/images/Minnow Treats crime scene-2.png on click
minnowHitbox.sourceOfGeometry: json/minnow-hitbox.geojson fetched at runtime with an approved fallback polygon only if the packaged GeoJSON cannot load.

frontendGameplay.transport: Apps Script POST bodies use text/plain;charset=UTF-8 to avoid JSON preflight failures on GitHub Pages
frontendGameplay.clock: Host client advances tested backend game.advance after each 60-second NIGHT hour; waits and retries while private actions are pending
frontendGameplay.dice: Backend actionPrompt chooses required d6/d12; joystick flick sends game.roll and animates the authoritative returned face
cards: final card reveal for every player
frontendGameplay.nightLock: Sleeping clients see a black viewport + Ferret Frenzy logo while shell/HUD and live countdown remain visible; gameplay controls are inert.
frontendGameplay.chatVoting: Morning Business uses a staged Discuss → Paw Point → Result flow; one shared discussion remains visible through voting; messages have clearer metadata and send guarding; Paw Point retains card-backed private selection plus a final server-authoritative lock.
frontendGameplay.controls: Physical gameplay controls are joystick + /1/ d6 + /2/ d12 + A confirm + B back + X role action. Private Info/Notebook remain HUD tools.
frontendGameplay.preGame: Role deal enters backend PREP, presented as Pre-Game Setup. The actual dealt role card must be acknowledged before the frontend enables the required setup roll/action prompt; Night begins only after backend setup completion.
frontendGameplay.solo: Solo + Bots creates a private target-4 room. On Start, empty seats are created as frontend guest bots; after the tested backend deals roles, each seat loads the matching Ferret Frenzy v3 specialized role brain.
frontendGameplay.botAutofill: No client-side role reservations. Bot guests join and ready before game.start; authoritative startingRole from game.state selects the role brain after the backend deal.
frontendGameplay.localFallback: Lobby-only local fallback is role-neutral; seat creation/joining never reserves or previews a role.

dossierAlignment.supersedes: Revision 3.2/3.1/3.0 wording only where Revision 3.3 explicitly clarifies secondary-resolution order, result provenance, live-help authority, and result refresh behavior
dossierAlignment.deal: Backend-authoritative random Active Set deal: one Starting Card per occupied seat plus three hidden Hammock cards; bots reserve no roles.
dossierAlignment.sameHourOrder: wake → Treat State before action → Raider theft → conversion/witness triggers → Starting-Role actions → commit
dossierAlignment.businessSoloInspection: Exactly one randomly selected wake result from one chosen player; never the target's full schedule.
dossierAlignment.dookerGlimpse: Current allegiance at the exact Glimpse timestamp; later movement may make the fact stale.
dossierAlignment.troubleConversion: Theft-window overlap converts Trouble before the blind swap and grants historical Raider identity.
dossierAlignment.snuggleBond: Bond-Reveal is a results reveal, not an additional Paw Point capture.
dossierAlignment.guardianProtection: Removes target from vote-capture eligibility; votes remain recorded for replay.
dossierAlignment.voting: One private Paw Point per active player for another active player; simultaneous lock; protected targets are excluded from capture totals; all eligible positive top ties are caught; no positive eligible total means no Paw Point capture.
dossierAlignment.primaryWin: Business must catch the historical Raider; catching only accomplices/converts is insufficient.
dossierAlignment.quickRoleClaim: Public statement builder only; never validates hidden truth. Starting Role and Current Card claim scopes are tracked separately, with optional wake chronology, Treat State, co-waker, and role-specific targets/results.
dossierAlignment.botPrivacy: Bots reason from authorized facts plus public claims; timestamped multi-wake testimony is not flattened into a single Treat State, and hidden roles are not exposed unless voluntarily claimed or publicly revealed.
help: Full Revision 3.3 How to Play in lobby
Short Revision 3.3 Quick How to Play in HUD
dossierAlignment.itchyClue: A valid two-player clue contains the historical Raider plus a legal non-Raider decoy; no-decoy edge cases must be explicitly marked degraded.
dossierAlignment.guardianDoctrine: Protection and Paw Point are separate choices; starting-Hunter recognition is historical/stale-able trust and does not force automatic protection.
dossierAlignment.hunterDoctrine: Converted Hunter has no Hunt Mark effect; frontend bot logic refuses loyal mark behavior after conversion.
dossierAlignment.targetLegality: All current player-targeting base role actions exclude self; Trouble/Snuggler require two distinct other targets; backend remains authoritative.
dossierAlignment.packagePreservation: Dossier passes carry forward the complete known-good game package by default; unexpected package shrinkage requires audit before release.
dossierAlignment.secondaryResolution: Paw Point catches -> valid loyal-Hunter Hunt Mark catch -> Snuggle Bond result reveal -> historical Raider primary-win check
dossierAlignment.resultProvenance: CAUGHT is a real capture state; BOND-REVEALED is a separate results-only reveal and never itself a catch.
dossierAlignment.resultRefresh: Authorized bondRevealed and optional catch-provenance changes invalidate result-note render signatures.

guides.lobby: Full Revision 3.3 How to Play: round flow, evidence taxonomy, role gotchas, exact secondary-resolution order, state separation, Paw Point, bots and privacy.
guides.hud: Short Revision 3.3 Quick How to Play with same-hour order, role clarifications, and Paw Point -> Hunt Mark -> Bond-Reveal resolution order.

chatVoting.persistentChat: Chat opens once at Morning Business and once at Paw Point phase entry; state polling no longer toggles it closed while typing.
chatVoting.targetSource: Current participant displayName values, including human usernames and bot usernames.
chatVoting.bluffing: Quick claims are public statements and are not validated against hidden truth. Starting Role and Current Card claims are distinct testimony fields.
chatVoting.botRolePrivacy: Role-specific bot evidence is gated until the bot deliberately volunteers a public role claim or is publicly revealed/caught.
chatVoting.quickClaimTimeline: Optional role-claim scope, claimed wake hours, Treat State, first co-waker, and timestamped role-specific details.
chatVoting.claimParser: Recognizes human Quick Role Claim and bot volunteer wording; stores Treat State by Burrow Hour; preserves PRESENT→MISSING same-window testimony; allows legal multi-wake disclosures; and never applies Starting-Role capability rules from a Current Card claim.

narrator.session: Reuses the current authenticated Ferret Frenzy player seat via window.FFNetwork.getState(); no second login/token entry.
narrator.voice: Browser speech synthesis; shared announcements can use room audio, private role prompts require local headphone confirmation.
narrator.chat: Host-owned shared narrator messages use existing chat.send with reserved [[FF_NARRATOR_V1]] marker and render as Ferret Frenzy Narrator on updated clients.
narrator.privacy: Private prompts/facts are never sent to shared chat.

chatChannels.turnFloor: host turn mode + raise paw queue + next turn + end turn
